title: Farmer's market
description: A harvest festival every time! Imagine a classic market square. The air is filled with exciting scents of freshly baked bread and fresh vegetables. Among the market stalls, customers are bustling, shopping and talking with local producers about cultivation and breeding. You stroll around in a sea of colors and get to taste local specialties that are otherwise hard to find, and the goods at the market are the freshest you can get! Take the opportunity to have a coffee. Since 2001, you can find the Farmer’s Market at the Yttre BorggÃ¥rden in LinkÃ¶ping. During nine autumn Saturdays every year, starting in August. A unique market – the wide range of local products, the friendly atmosphere, and the selection that follows the seasons make the market special, but we also have two rules that make us unique. One rule means that the producer you buy from must have grown or raised what is sold at the market. The same applies to the main ingredient in processed food, such as jam or sausage. The second rule states that the goods must be locally produced, which means that the farms must be within a distance of 250 km from the market. Welcome!

title: Orsa Spelmån, Tina Ahlin & Bengan Janson
description: Few groups can shine with such a list of merits – the KaRAMELodikt Prize, the Monica Zetterlund Scholarship, the Tage Danielsson’s Friends Award, the Taube Scholarship, and the Zorn’s Gold Badge. Together, Orsa Spelmån with Tina Ahlin and Bengan Janson form a musical dream team that is now embarking on a highly anticipated Swedish tour in 2026! With their hearts deeply rooted in the Swedish musical treasure, they offer an evening filled with warmth, joyful playing, and masterful interplay. The repertoire is rich in classics and gems from collaborations with greats like Benny Andersson, Hasse Alfredson, Sven-Bertil Taube, Robert Broberg, Allan Edwall, and Olle Adolphson – just to name a few. Welcome to an unforgettable evening where the audience can sing along, laugh, and enjoy musical gems served with humor, heart, and a contagious joy of playing that only this ensemble can deliver!

The rally offers thrilling motorsport, classic rally cars, and a unique atmosphere – right in the heart of Ästergötland.
